description: A family office's own agent claims the seat of its own record. Give card_url (the https URL of the office agent's card) and record_id (the record id as the graph serves it). The record must resolve to the name the card gives; the door then issues a domain challenge (DNS TXT _fo-kg-seat.<domain> or https://<domain>/.well-known/fo-kg-seat.txt). Call again with challenge_id: proven → the record moves listed → claimed and the seat key is answered once. With seat_key and rows, the seat sets its own fields on its own record only (website, aliases, sectors, structure, description, contact_url); the sourced fields are never touched and verified is set by a person, never by a tool. The seat settles on /seat (x402).

card_url.description: https URL of the office agent's card (A2A agent card JSON)

challenge_id.description: the challenge_id from the accepted claim, once the token is published

record_id.description: the office's record id as the graph serves it (resolve_family_office lists it)

seat_key.description: the seat key answered when the claim was proven (for rows)

name: claim_seat
